mechanism: Darunavir (a CYP3A4 substrate and inhibitor) may increase amoxicillin clavulanate levels through hepatic metabolism alterations, and concomitant use requires monitoring for beta-lactam toxicity and potential effects on protease inhibitor absorption.
action: Monitor for increased beta-lactam side effects; no dose adjustment typically needed for amoxicillin, but ensure adequate renal function assessment as both drugs are renally eliminated; consider timing of administration to optimize absorption.
